Three failed interpretations: motif starting at marker; wrongly omit leading 9; motif centered differently (offset -1). Demos from this task family show variable motif widths and colors, so identify the exemplar motif from non-background cells, then determine its midpoint anchor and replicate. Some exemplars include the marker color as motif component and shapes can vary; do not assume universally three cells. Validate every output row/column and preserve exemplar.
